mapper.select: SELECT source_id, target_id, bandwidth, latency, status, measurement_time FROM node_link_metric
SELECT source_id, target_id, bandwidth, latency, status, measurement_time FROM node_link_metric WHERE source_id = LEAST(#{sourceId}, #{targetId}) AND target_id = GREATEST(#{sourceId}, #{targetId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_link_metric (source_id, target_id, bandwidth, latency, status, measurement_time) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{bandwidth}, #{latency}, #{status}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bandwidth = COALESCE(VALUES(bandwidth), bandwidth), latency = COALESCE(VALUES(latency), latency), status = VALUES(status), measurement_time = VALUES(measurement_time)
